frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes a state of unsettled uncertainty: the mind held in suspension between alternatives, not firmly decided/convinced about the truth of some object-claim. In every occurrence it names a subject's non-settledness regarding a specific matter (a revelation, a religion, the Hereafter, a messenger's call, or God). After subtracting the noun form and its construction, the residue is "wavering / lack of firm conviction about X" — neither knowledge (علم/يقين) nor mere leaning (ظنّ), but an interior non-resolution.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every one of the 15 confirmed occurrences is the noun شَكّ ("doubt"). Fourteen appear in the locative construction (لـ)فِى شَكٍّ — "(they/you are) IN doubt" — treating doubt as a state one is inside of. The remaining one (14:10) is the nominative in a rhetorical question, أَفِى ٱللَّهِ شَكٌّ ("Is there any doubt about God?"), which presupposes there should be none — still the same noun with the same meaning. In each case the object of doubt is introduced by مِن / مِمَّا / مِنْه / مِنْها (about my religion 10:104, about what We sent down 10:94, about it 11:110, about what you call us to 11:62/14:9, about the Hereafter 27:66/34:21, about My reminder 38:8, about what came to you 40:34, about it 41:45/42:14/4:157). Two (34:54, 44:9) leave the object implicit but the context (revelation/the reckoning) is identical. The contribution — being unsettled/uncertain about a truth-claim — is demonstrably present in all 15.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: a single lexeme, the noun/verbal-noun شَكّ (form N, 15/15) — no morphological variation to subtract. CONSTRUCTION: locative فِى شَكّ ("in a state of doubt") in 14/15, often with emphatic لـ (لَفِى شَكٍّ) — this contributes the "being-inside-a-state" framing, not the doubt itself; 14:10 uses شَكّ as subject of an existential rhetorical question. OBJECT/PARTICIPANTS: the doubted matter is a separate slot filled by مِن/مِمَّا phrases (religion, revelation, Hereafter, reminder, messenger's call, God); the doubters are consistently disbelievers/addressees resisting a messenger. QUALIFIER: مُرِيب ("disquieting/suspicion-inducing," from ريب) modifies شَكّ in 6 places (11:110, 11:62, 14:9, 34:54, 41:45, 42:14) — this is an added adjective, not part of the root residue. RESIDUE after stripping all of the above: the bare interior state of uncertainty / non-firmness of conviction.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 14:10 — أَفِى ٱللَّهِ شَكٌّ ("Is there any doubt concerning God?"). This is the only non-فِى-شَكّ-state token: شَكّ is nominative subject of a rhetorical existential question, and its object is God's very reality rather than a revelation/message. It is also the only case where the verse's rhetorical thrust asserts doubt should NOT exist. Yet the lexical contribution is unchanged — the word still denotes uncertainty about a truth, and the rhetorical question only works because شَكّ means exactly "unsettled uncertainty." It does not resist the proposed residue; it confirms it by negation.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: That the residue is not neutral "uncertainty" but "disquieting suspicion / troubled misgiving" — i.e. that شَكّ collapses into the sense of ريب (rayb). This is tempting because مُرِيب co-occurs with شَكّ six times.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: The competing hypothesis fails precisely on the co-occurrence data: because شَكٍّ مُّرِيب ("doubt that disquiets") uses مُرِيب as an adjective qualifying شَكّ, the two cannot be synonyms — a word does not take its own meaning as a modifier. This shows شَكّ is the neutral base state (uncertainty) onto which ريب adds "disquiet/suspicion." شَكّ is likewise distinct from (a) ظنّ "conjecture/leaning" — contrasted in 4:157 where the doubters, lacking knowledge, "follow only ظنّ" while being فِى شَكّ; (b) علم / يقين "knowledge/certainty" — the polar opposite the doubters lack; and (c) امتراء (mry) — 10:94 moves from "if you are in شَكّ" to "be not of the مُمْتَرِين." The residue "unsettled non-conviction about a truth-claim" is non-empty, distinctive, and falsifiable (it would fail if any occurrence used شَكّ for settled certainty, physical piercing/interlacing, or mere emotional distress without an epistemic object — none do).
internal_discovery.rationale: Full coverage: all 15 confirmed occurrences assessed, all 15 consistent. The root is mono-form (noun شَكّ, 15/15), giving unusually clean separation: there is no verbal morphology to disentangle, only the recurrent locative construction فِى شَكّ (14/15) and an object slot, both of which are cleanly subtractable. After removing form, the "in-a-state" construction, the object phrases, and the adjectival qualifier مُرِيب, a single stable residue remains in every occurrence — the interior state of unsettled uncertainty / non-firm conviction about a truth-claim. It is present even in the one structurally deviant token (14:10, rhetorical nominative), which relies on that exact meaning. The residue is non-empty, falsifiable, and distinctive against the nearest roots ريب (disquiet — shown by adjectival co-occurrence to be additive, not identical), ظنّ (conjecture, explicitly contrasted in 4:157), and علم/يقين (its opposite). No occurrence resists; universal presence holds.

adversarial_verification.notes:
All 15 confirmed occurrences are the single noun form شَكّ in a prepositional construction — 13 explicitly as فِى شَكٍّ مِّن X ("in doubt about X") and the collocation شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍ. After subtracting the noun form and its construction, the residue "wavering / lack of firm conviction about a specific matter X" is demonstrably present in every one: religion (10:104), the revelation (10:94, 40:34), the scripture/Reminder (11:110, 38:8, 41:45, 42:14, 4:157), the messengers' call (11:62, 14:9), God (14:10), and the Hereafter (27:66, 34:21).

Adversarial resistance was concentrated on the two occurrences where the object-claim X is syntactically elided: 34:54 (شكّ مريب) and 44:9 (فى شكّ يلعبون). In both, X is not carried by the construction but supplied by immediate context (resurrection/the message; the promised Day/smoke), and the minimal residue — non-settledness / lack of firm conviction — survives even 44:9's dismissive-mocking register. Neither defeats universal presence; they are elided-object constructions, not counterexamples. No occurrence carries a sense of certainty, of a definite leaning, or of the classical physical "splitting" sense.

Distinctiveness is corroborated internally: 27:66 and 4:157 oppose شكّ to علم (knowledge); 4:157 keeps شكّ separable from ظنّ (they doubt AND merely conjecture); and the recurring qualifier مريب treats شكّ (the doubt-state) as distinct from ريب's disquiet. The claim is falsifiable (a certainty/leaning/physical-splitting sense would refute it) and is not falsified by any occurrence. Under non-negotiable root unity, universal presence holds across all 15.
